GmailDock v0.3.1

Fixes for two problems introduced in v0.3.0.

- The Inbox unread count shows again on the taskbar or dock, in the window title and in the tray tooltip.
- After Google account prompts (such as the selfie-video recovery screen), "Not now" and "Continue" now keep you in GmailDock instead of opening Gmail in your browser. GmailDock now recognises Google's country domains, such as google.lk and google.co.uk.
- Security: Gmail's page can now only report the unread count to GmailDock. It can no longer change settings or start an update.
- Links sent to your browser are now recorded in the log file, which helps when reporting problems.

Windows is the currently tested platform. macOS and Linux users are invited to test and report issues.
